# SsdIndicator

Keeps the SSD icon on bodies that died while their player was away. Upstream hides the icon on every dead body,
since a player who ghosts after dying also counts as SSD, so a body looted after an SSD death looked like any other
corpse. The server `WFDiedSsdSystem` adds `WFDiedSsdComponent` when a body with a mind dies while SSD, and removes
it when the body is revived or its player comes back. The client `SSDIndicatorSystem` still shows the icon on a dead
body that carries the component.
